messages:
Sofia: Heads-up from the daily billing scan — ~240 GPU-hours charged to project 'playground-v2' yesterday with no cost center tag. tagging/alloc scripts show empty cost_center. Can someone own? :wave:
Jon: Oof. Any sample rows from the export?
Sofia: pasted a row from cloud_billing_export.csv
Sofia: 
Sofia: resource_name: compute.googleapis.com/instances
Sofia: project: playground-v2
Sofia: sku_description: NVIDIA_A10G
Sofia: start_time: 2025-07-08T11:04:00Z
Sofia: end_time: 2025-07-08T20:34:00Z
Sofia: usage: 9.5
Sofia: cost_usd: 1,800.45
Sofia: labels: {}

Priya: playground-v2 is used for experiments + partner demos sometimes. If a partner trial instance was misconfigured it could land here.
BillingBot: Alert triggered: project_untagged_gpu_hours > 100 (24h). Ticket created: FIN-893. Link: https://billing.redwood.internal/tickets/FIN-893
InfraBot: Audit query completed. Launch events matching window show 4 instances created by accounts: evan.partnertrial, ci-onboard, sofia.testuser, and demo-bot. The two largest instances were created by evan.partnertrial (external partner).
Evan: That external identity is from a short-term partner sandbox we spun up last week. They were supposed to be on partner-namespace but a terraform var was wrong in the onboarding template. Sorry folks.
Jon: We need two things: 1) move cost off internal budgets (ledger adjustment or chargeback to partner) and 2) harden the onboarding terraform + CI to require cost_center label.
Priya: Finance — do you accept a retrospective backcharge to the customer's trial invoice, or do you need a GL journal? Also need confirmation if partner trial had a paid contract or complimentary credits.
Sofia: Fin wants a documented approval before adjusting ledger. Recommend we add a short approval step in FIN-893 linking Partnerships approval + Partner contract ID.
BillingBot: FIN-893 status: awaiting_finance_approval. Current approvals: partnerships_pending, infra_pending.
Evan: Partnerships confirms trial should be billed to acme-tn-044 (contract). I'll attach email thread to FIN-893.
Jon: Infra will run a targeted tag-backfill: will add label cost_center=acme_trial to the instances and push a ledger adjustment entry tagged FIN-893. We'll record the audit events.
Priya: Finance notes: for charges > $5k we need a two-step approval (Finance Manager + Controller). This is ~1.8k on one line but total cluster ~3.6k. I'll route to controller if combined chargebacks exceed threshold.
Sofia: Short term mitigation: disabling self-service GPU provisioning in playground-v2 until onboarding fix is live. Will that disrupt active demos? Evan: small impact — we'll notify partners.
Jon: Long term: enforce label via org policy + terraform variable validation. Also add pre-provision billing dry-run in the onboarding flow.
Sofia: Action list pinned in FIN-893: (1) Partnerships attach contract and approve chargeback, (2) Finance approve ledger adjustment, (3) Infra run backfill + emit audit logs, (4) Disable self-service temporarily, (5) Infra patch onboarding template. Will update when FIN-893 moves. :white_check_mark:
